items.description:
Dis-Chem Pharmacy Okavango Crossing is the Dis-Chem branch trading from Shop 13 inside Okavango Crossing shopping centre, on the corner of Okavango and Langeberg Road in Kraaifontein. The store carries the dispensary, beauty, health and wellness ranges the national Dis-Chem chain is known for, alongside a Click & Collect service for customers picking up online orders in-store.

Dis-Chem has traded in South Africa since 1978 and has grown into a nationwide pharmacy and retail chain, combining a dispensary with ranges spanning skincare, personal care and everyday wellness products. This branch serves residents and shoppers across Kraaifontein and the surrounding northern Cape Town suburbs, and is open Monday to Friday from 8:30am to 7pm, Saturdays from 8:30am to 5pm, and Sundays and public holidays from 9am to 5pm.

items.description:
Eagles' Nest is a boutique wine estate on the steep slopes of the Constantia mountain range, producing Sauvignon Blanc, Viognier, Shiraz and Merlot from vineyards planted at elevations of roughly 100 to 400 metres. The property's history stretches back to the late 1600s, when it operated as a commercial farm exporting fruit and supplying vegetables to the local market.

A devastating fire in 2000 destroyed most of the estate's natural fynbos, and the farm used the rebuild as a turning point, shifting its focus to winemaking while restoring the indigenous vegetation and planting tens of thousands of Silver Tree seeds that have grown into one of South Africa's largest Silver Tree plantations. The estate today offers wine tastings alongside cheese and charcuterie platters, and runs a wine club for regular visitors, on Constantia Main Road in Constantia.

Eden Beauty Collection is a hair and beauty salon at 6A Kromboom Road in Rondebosch, Cape Town. Its services include hair styling, hair extensions, laser hair removal, manicures and pedicures, gel nails, waxing and threading. Lash services cover classic, hybrid and volume lashes, along with lamination and lift treatments.

The salon has a 4.9 rating from more than 1,700 reviews on its Fresha booking page, and its team has more than eight practitioners. The Fresha listing also shows package deals and promotions. Clients can book online, and the salon suits people in Rondebosch who want hair, nails, lashes and laser treatments in an upmarket but relaxed setting.

items.description:
Estilo Hair is a unisex hair salon in The Old Bakery on Main Road in Lakeside, Cape Town. Its services include cuts and styling, balayage, highlights, blow dries, children's haircuts, curly hair, hair braiding, colouring, extensions, weaves, keratin treatments and locs.

The salon uses Davines hair products, and it offers manicures and pedicures with OPI and Essie polishes. Clients can book through its Fresha listing, which shows the salon's address and services. Its Fresha profile lists hair services alongside nail treatments, so clients can book several services at once. It suits clients in Lakeside and nearby suburbs who want hair and nail work in one place.

Eversdal Primary School is a public primary school on Stepping Stonesweg in Eversdal, Durbanville, teaching Grades 1 to 7. The school runs a dedicated aftercare programme alongside separate academic contacts for its foundation phase and intersen phase, plus its own sport, finance and learner-care functions, reflecting a structure built around more than just the classroom day.

School hours for learners vary by grade for the 2026 year, with the youngest grades finishing earliest in the day and learners in Grades 4 to 7 staying until mid-afternoon on most days. Eversdal Primary is a feeder school to both Durbanville High School and Fairmont High School, and serves families across Eversdal, Durbanville and the surrounding suburbs who want a structured primary education close to home.

Exclusive Books is a South African book retailer with a branch inside Constantia Village, trading as Shop 46 on Spaanschemat River Road in Constantia. The store stocks fiction, non-fiction, memoirs and gift titles from South African and international authors, alongside stationery and children's books, continuing its role as one of the country's long-established bookshop chains.

The Constantia Village branch is listed as a bookstore within the centre's own store directory, open Monday to Friday from 9am to 6pm and Saturdays from 9am to 5pm. It suits local residents and shoppers looking to browse new releases, find a gift, or pick up a title while running other errands at the centre.

items.description:
Famous Kalahari Biltong is a biltong and dried-meat specialist trading from Shop 29 at Richmond Corner, on the corner of Plattekloof and Tygerberg Valley Roads in Richwood, Milnerton. The range includes premium A-grade Karoo beef biltong, free-range grass-fed Kalahari beef biltong, pichanha-style yellow-fat biltong, and Karoo and Namibian-style beef droëwors, alongside chilli beef and chicken sticks for snacking.

Customers can buy over the counter or order through a delivery platform that lists the Richmond Corner branch alongside its full product range, making it a convenient stop for biltong, droëwors and other dried-meat snacks without travelling further afield. The store serves biltong lovers across Richwood, Milnerton and the surrounding northern suburbs, whether stocking up for a braai or craving a quick snack.

items.description:
Flooring Warehouse has a showroom in Paarden Eiland at 39 Gold Street, North Gate Estate, Cape Town. It supplies and installs laminates, carpets, vinyls, and solid wood, bamboo and SPC flooring, along with skirting and trims.

The company describes its range as the widest in South Africa, and it offers a fully installed flooring service for homes and businesses. Customers can visit the showroom or call the branch, and the contact page lists its opening hours for each day of the week. The showroom suits homeowners, builders and businesses in Paarden Eiland and the surrounding northern suburbs who need flooring supplied and fitted.

items.description:
The Greek Club Restaurant serves Greek cuisine and seafood from its premises on Bay Road in Mouille Point, with a menu spanning gyros, fried halloumi, moussaka, hummus and aubergine dips alongside other light meals. The restaurant caters for casual diners and larger groups alike, hosting functions and high teas as well as everyday lunches and dinners.

Facilities include takeaway service, vegetarian options, Wi-Fi and free off-street parking, making it a practical choice for families and groups who want a sit-down meal without the hassle of finding parking nearby. Customer reviews describe a lively atmosphere and attentive staff, and the restaurant is a regular choice for celebrations as well as everyday meals with friends and family in Mouille Point.

items.description:
Hair Ambitions is a hair salon in Plattekloof Village on Plattekloof Road, Cape Town. It was formerly known as Eclipse Styling Studio and was bought over at the beginning of 2011. The salon offers colour, highlights, cutting, styling, Brazilian blow dries, hair extensions and a nail bar.

The salon is Goldwell-affiliated and uses KMS and Joico products. Its village listing describes it as one of the trendier salons in the area and says it strives for service excellence. Its village location sits alongside convenience shops such as Pick n Pay and Woolworths. It suits clients in Plattekloof and nearby suburbs who want colour, styling and nail services in one visit.

Health on Point is a boutique pharmacy on Surrey Place in Mouille Point, offering prescription dispensing, in-store consultations and a retail range of medicines, vitamins, supplements and skincare products. The pharmacy serves residents and visitors in the Mouille Point area who need everyday healthcare products as well as dispensed medication.

Its extended trading hours set it apart from many neighbourhood pharmacies: the store is open every day of the week, including public holidays, from 9am to 9pm. That makes it a reliable option for picking up a prescription or health essentials outside typical office hours, whether early in the morning, late in the evening, or over a weekend, for anyone living in or visiting Mouille Point.

High Constantia Wine Cellar is a boutique winery on a Constantia Valley property with a history dating back to 1693, producing estate wines including Sauvignon Blanc, Shiraz and Cabernet Franc alongside its own olive oil and Methode Cap Classique. Bottles can be bought online for shipping or collected from the estate, and the cellar also takes bookings for wine tastings.

Tastings are held outdoors on the estate's patio rather than in a restaurant setting, giving visitors a relaxed, open-air way to taste through the current range. The wine shop and tasting bookings suit wine lovers and visitors exploring the Constantia Valley wine route, on a property that has been producing wine in the area for more than three centuries.

items.description:
Hungry Lion Steenberg is a branch of the Hungry Lion fried-chicken chain, trading from Shop 1 and 2 in Steenberg Centre on Military Road. Hungry Lion was founded in 1997 and has grown into a nationwide fast-food chain, serving fried chicken, burgers, chicken fingers, winglets and family meal buckets alongside sweet treats and soft drinks.

The Steenberg branch's own page describes its focus on sharing more with customers through bigger flavour and better value, and the restaurant also runs regular daily specials and works with delivery partners for customers who would rather eat at home. It is a straightforward, affordable stop for dine-in or takeaway fried chicken and fast food for families and individuals in and around Steenberg.

The International School of Cape Town is a Cambridge school in Bishopscourt, Cape Town, teaching from Nursery through to High School and A Levels. The school describes itself as one of the oldest Cambridge schools in the country, offering the Cambridge curriculum since 1998.

The school says it combines excellent academic results with a warm and supportive environment, and it uses the latest in teaching methods and technology. Cambridge qualifications are accepted by more than 1,400 universities, and students can transfer between more than 10,000 Cambridge schools in over 160 countries. It suits families who want an internationally recognised curriculum for their children.

Italo's is a family-owned Italian deli and restaurant on the corner of Kildare Road and Main Street in Cardiff Castle, Newlands, open since January 2020. The deli counter sits at the heart of the business, stocked with pasta, freshly baked bread, cheeses, antipasti, ready-made meals and baked treats, alongside vinaigrettes, relishes and a selection of wines, with a separate free-range butchery trading alongside it.

The restaurant is fully licensed and dog-friendly, with outdoor seating across a series of small piazza-style tables for breakfast, lunch or dinner, and it also caters for private functions and events. Customers can pick up a last-minute gift such as Italian nougat, biscotti or artisanal chocolates on their way out. It is a relaxed, old-school Italian spot for locals in Newlands and the southern suburbs looking for a deli and restaurant combination in one visit.

Joon Restaurant is a Mediterranean-style eatery on Palmer Road in Muizenberg Village Centre, serving breakfast, lunch and dinner alongside barista-made coffee, home-baked treats and Italian-style thin-crust pizzas. The kitchen also turns out deli-style meals and daily specials, with diners praising dishes such as charred olives, chermoula-spiced sirloin and flatbread since its relaunch as Joon Mediterranean Muizenberg.

The restaurant caters for private events alongside its everyday service, and welcomes both children and dogs at its tables. Beyond meals, it hosts a run of community evenings through the week, including poetry nights, pub quizzes, live music and its regular Village Vibes events, making it as much a neighbourhood gathering spot as a place to eat. It suits locals in Muizenberg looking for a relaxed meal or a reason to go out in the evening.

Kenridge Pre-Primary School is an independent, dual-medium pre-school in Kenridge, Durbanville, offering Pre-Grade R and Grade R classes. The school's play-based daily programme is built around holistic development, stimulating learners' social, emotional, physical and academic growth rather than focusing on classroom instruction alone.

Registered with the Western Cape Education Department, the school is run around the idea that play is a child's most valuable form of learning, supported by a nurturing and dedicated teaching staff working to create a warm and safe environment for each child. An aftercare programme is also available for families needing care beyond school hours. It suits families with Pre-Grade R and Grade R children in Kenridge and the surrounding Durbanville suburbs looking for a play-based start to schooling.

items.description:
Kraaifontein Hardware is a family-run hardware store in Belmont Park, Kraaifontein, established in 1975. Its range covers building materials, sand and gravel, bricks, cement and cement blocks, steel reinforcing and steel-cutting equipment, timber, and wood-cutting equipment.

The store also stocks plumbing equipment, tools, drilling and abrasive equipment, nuts and bolts, screws, keys and electrical supplies, along with paint and housewares. Its website describes the business as having passion and care for hardware. The store has traded in Belmont Park since it was established in 1975. It suits builders, tradespeople and homeowners in Kraaifontein who need materials and tools from one local store.

La Marzocco South Africa is the official South African arm of the Italian espresso-machine maker, operating a showroom at The Old Biscuit Mill in Woodstock alongside its corporate offices. The brand is dedicated to manufacturing specialty coffee equipment, with espresso machines, grinders and barista accessories for home enthusiasts, independent cafes and larger commercial coffee operations.

Through its showroom and collections, customers can explore La Marzocco's espresso-machine and grinder ranges and get access to the Accademia del Caffe Espresso, the brand's training and education arm for baristas and coffee professionals. The company positions itself around craftsmanship, sustainability and a long-standing commitment to the coffee trade, with its Woodstock base serving as the local point of contact for sales and support.

items.description:
Leopards Panel Beaters is an auto body repair shop in Epping, Cape Town. It offers panel beating, accident repair, spray painting, dent repair, buff and polish, rust removal, scratch removal and leak detection.

The business presents itself as a trusted panel beater in Cape Town, and it says it combines affordable prices with quality work. Its site lists its services and an about section for customers who want to know more. Accident repair is handled alongside cosmetic work such as scratch and dent removal, so one shop covers most body damage. It suits vehicle owners in Epping and the surrounding northern suburbs who need bodywork, paint or minor damage repaired.

Lion's Bread is an artisan sourdough bakery founded in Bo-Kaap in 2024, making bread with no additives beyond flour, water and salt. The loaves use a diverse mix of grains leavened through wild fermentation, a process the bakery says makes the bread more digestible, nutritious and flavourful than a standard loaf, alongside a curated range of pastries built around South African ingredients.

The bakery now trades from several current locations around Cape Town, including its original Bo-Kaap site, with bakers arriving before dawn each day to shape, score and bake each batch by hand. Lion's Bread suits customers looking for slow-fermented sourdough and freshly baked pastries alongside coffee, whether picking up a loaf for the week or stopping in for a quick treat in Bo-Kaap.

items.description:
Marine Solutions is a Cape Town company founded in 1999 to support the offshore industry in Southern Africa, and it now works more widely. Its main areas are ROV sales, ROV equipment support and pilot and technical training, along with cable assembly, manufacturing and overmoulding.

The company says its strength is the practical and technical knowledge its team has gained across different engineering fields. It recently achieved an ISO certification covering quality, environment and safety. Its work spans sales, support, training and cable assembly, so clients can use one supplier for equipment and trained staff. It suits offshore and subsea clients who need ROV equipment, support or trained pilots.

Mark One Hair Design is a hair salon trading from Shop 16 in Strand Pavilion on Beach Road, Strand, offering balayage, keratin treatments and women's haircuts. The salon's listed services focus on colour and treatment work rather than a broad beauty menu, giving clients a focused choice of hair services in one appointment.

The salon is closed on Mondays and Sundays, operating Tuesday to Friday from 8:30am to 5pm and Saturdays from 8:30am to 1pm, fitting around a typical working week for clients who need an early-morning or lunchtime appointment. It suits clients in Strand and the surrounding Helderberg area looking for a straightforward hair salon for colour and treatment services close to home.

items.description:
Merrypak & Print is a packaging manufacturer in Ndabeni producing paper carrier bags and boxes, supplied off the shelf in small quantities alongside custom orders. The business operates from two buildings in Ndabeni: one housing its production facilities, and the other home to its retail store, Merrypak Print & Copy counter and an on-site Good Food Cafe.

Alongside its own bag and box manufacturing, the Print & Copy side of the business offers printing and copying services, giving customers a single site for packaging supplies and basic print jobs. The cafe adds a place for customers and staff to grab food while visiting the premises. It serves businesses and individuals across Ndabeni and the wider Cape Town area who need carrier bags, boxes, printing or copying done locally.

Migal Vanas Photography is a photography studio trading from Unit A042 on the first floor of The Palms Emporium in Woodstock, specialising in fashion, lifestyle and portrait work. The studio also shoots commercial and casting headshots and corporate event photography, with retouching handled in-house for commercial clients.

The studio's work extends well beyond Cape Town, with projects shot in more than 60 countries for commercial and fashion clients internationally. That international reach sits alongside its home base in Woodstock, where it takes bookings for individual portrait sessions as well as larger commercial and corporate shoots. It suits brands, agencies and individuals looking for a photographer comfortable with both studio portraiture and location-based commercial and fashion work.

Millside Mica is a hardware and paint store in Millside Park on Old Mill Road in Ndabeni, Cape Town. It offers paint tinting and mixing, power tools, pre-cut timber and building materials, garden supplies and key cutting, for DIY and home improvement projects.

The store is part of Mica, which the group describes as one of the largest hardware groups in Africa, with more than 160 stores. The group is member owned and managed, and it provides training, marketing and store development support to its members. It suits DIY customers, builders and home owners in Ndabeni and the surrounding area who want paint and building supplies in one place.

items.description:
Out of Africa is an African gifts and souvenirs store on the Upper Level of Victoria Wharf at the V&A Waterfront. It sells authentic African gifts, crafts and curios, including handcrafted ceramics, basketry, home decor and jewellery.

The store's listing features local makers, and the products are sourced through community upliftment programmes, according to the store. The Waterfront listing gives a rating of 3.7 from 32 Google reviews. Its gifts range from small curios to home decor. It suits visitors who want to take home a gift or souvenir from Cape Town, and shoppers looking for handcrafted African products.
